desc:
🐲 Welcome to Dragons' Life! 🐲
Take to the skies and experience life as a dragon in a handcrafted fantasy world designed for roleplay, discovery, and freedom. Dragons’ Life is a complete rebuild of the 2022 game, featuring all-new dragon models, smoother animations, gems, and reworked core systems.

Shape your own story as you explore the land, uncover hidden secrets, and interact with the world around you. Personalize your dragon with distinct colors, materials, and accessories, and express yourself through animations and roleplay.

🔥 What You Can Do
🎨 Design a dragon that’s uniquely yours
🗺️ Travel and explore an open fantasy world
🗻 Fly freely 
👥 Roleplay with strangers or friends
✨ Progress and earn rewards through gameplay

MAIN DEVELOPERS:
🦊 Shyfoox
🛠️ Neyla
💻 DutchDeveloper

Tags: Animal, Open World, Fantasy, Exploration, RPG, Social
